entries.name: Blinded
entries.summary: You can't see.

entries.name: Broken
entries.summary: Broken is a condition that affects only objects.

entries.name: Clumsy
entries.summary: Your movements become clumsy and inexact.

entries.name: Concealed
entries.summary: You are difficult for one or more creatures to see due to thick fog or some other obscuring feature.

entries.name: Confused
entries.summary: You don't have your wits about you, and you attack wildly.

entries.name: Controlled
entries.summary: You have been commanded, magically dominated, or otherwise had your will subverted.

entries.name: Cursebound
entries.summary: Your oracular curse is constricting around you as you receive divine punishment after drawing too deeply on your mystery's powers.

entries.name: Dazzled
entries.summary: Your eyes are overstimulated or your vision is swimming.

entries.name: Deafened
entries.summary: You can't hear.

entries.name: Doomed
entries.summary: Your soul has been gripped by a powerful force that calls you closer to death.

entries.name: Drained
entries.summary: Your health and vitality have been depleted as you've lost blood, life force, or some other essence.

entries.name: Dying
entries.summary: You are bleeding out or otherwise at death's door.

entries.name: Encumbered
entries.summary: You are carrying more weight than you can manage.

entries.name: Enfeebled
entries.summary: You're physically weakened.

entries.name: Fascinated
entries.summary: You're compelled to focus your attention on something, distracting you from whatever else is going on around you.

entries.name: Fatigued
entries.summary: You're tired and can't summon much energy.

entries.name: Fleeing
entries.summary: You're forced to run away due to fear or some other compulsion.

entries.name: Friendly
entries.summary: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC.

entries.name: Frightened
entries.summary: You're gripped by fear and struggle to control your nerves.

entries.name: Glitching
entries.summary: A glitching creature, hazard, or object with the tech trait experiences a combination of debilitating effects and moments of seizing up.

entries.name: Grabbed
entries.summary: You're held in place by another creature, giving you the Off-Guard and Immobilized conditions.

entries.name: Helpful
entries.summary: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC.

entries.name: Hidden
entries.summary: While you're hidden from a creature, that creature knows the space you're in but can't tell precisely where you are.

entries.name: Hostile
entries.summary: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose on a PC.

entries.name: Immobilized
entries.summary: You are incapable of movement.

entries.name: Indifferent
entries.summary: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC.

entries.name: Invisible
entries.summary: You can't be seen.

entries.name: Observed
entries.summary: Anything in plain view is observed by you.

entries.name: Off-Guard
entries.summary: You're distracted or otherwise unable to focus your full attention on defense.

entries.name: Paralyzed
entries.summary: You're frozen in place.

entries.name: Persistent Damage
entries.summary: You are taking damage from an ongoing effect, such as from being lit on fire.

entries.name: Petrified
entries.summary: You have been turned to stone.

entries.name: Prone
entries.summary: You're lying on the ground.

entries.name: Quickened
entries.summary: You're able to act more quickly.

entries.name: Restrained
entries.summary: You're tied up and can barely move, or a creature has you pinned.

entries.name: Sickened
entries.summary: rules

entries.name: Slowed
entries.summary: You have fewer actions.

entries.name: Stunned
entries.summary: You've become senseless.

entries.name: Stupefied
entries.summary: Your thoughts and instincts are clouded.

entries.name: Suppressed
entries.summary: You've been affected by a high volume of incoming fire or a particularly dangerous attack that forces you to act less efficiently for your own safety.

entries.name: Unconscious
entries.summary: You're sleeping or have been knocked out.

entries.name: Undetected
entries.summary: When you are undetected by a creature, that creature can't see you at all, has no idea what space you occupy, and can't target you, though you still can be affected by abilities that target an area.

entries.name: Unfriendly
entries.summary: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC.

entries.name: Unnoticed
entries.summary: If you're unnoticed by a creature, that creature has no idea you're present.

entries.name: Untethered
entries.summary: You're in a zero gravity (or similar) environment without a means of movement and float without support.

entries.name: Wounded
entries.summary: You have been seriously injured.

entries.name: Access Infosphere
entries.summary: Requirements You are using a device with infosphere access.

entries.name: Administer First Aid
entries.summary: Requirements You're wearing or holding a medkit.

entries.name: Aid
entries.summary: Trigger An ally is about to use an action that requires a skill check or attack roll.

entries.name: Analyze Environment
entries.summary: Requirements You have environmental protection on your armor or a field scientist's kit You analyze your environment to determine whether it's safe by checking the gauges and sensors on your armor or a field scientist's…

entries.name: Area Fire
entries.summary: You attempt to hit each creature in a designated area, which has a range equal to the weapon's range increment (for cone or line) or a designated radius of the explosion (for burst).

entries.name: Arrest a Fall
entries.summary: Trigger You fall.

entries.name: Auto-Fire
entries.summary: You attempt to hit each creature in a cone with a range equal to half the weapon's range increment without making an attack roll.

entries.name: Avert Gaze
entries.summary: You avert your gaze from danger.

entries.name: Avoid Notice
entries.summary: You attempt a Stealth check to avoid notice while traveling at half speed.

entries.name: Balance
entries.summary: Requirements You are in a square that contains a narrow surface, uneven ground, or another similar feature.

entries.name: Borrow an Arcane Spell
entries.summary: If you're an arcane spellcaster who prepares from a spellbook, you can attempt to prepare a spell from someone else's spellbook.

entries.name: Burrow
entries.summary: Requirements You have a burrow Speed.

entries.name: Cast a Spell
entries.summary: Spells can vary in how many actions they take, as shown in the spell's stat block.

entries.name: Climb
entries.summary: Requirements You have both hands free You attempt an Athletics check to move a maximum distance of 5 feet up, down, or across an incline.

entries.name: Coerce
entries.summary: With threats either veiled or overt, you attempt to bully a creature into doing what you want.

entries.name: Command an Animal
entries.summary: You issue an order to an animal.

entries.name: Conceal an Object
entries.summary: You hide a small object on your person (such as a weapon of light Bulk).

entries.name: Cover Tracks
entries.summary: You cover your tracks, moving up to half your travel Speed, using the Travel Speed rules.

entries.name: Craft
entries.summary: You can make an item from raw materials.

entries.name: Crawl
entries.summary: Requirements You are prone and your Speed is at least 10 feet.

entries.name: Create a Diversion
entries.summary: With a gesture, a trick, or some distracting words, you can create a diversion that draws creatures' attention elsewhere.

entries.name: Create Forgery
entries.summary: Requirements You provide the proper writing materials for your forgery.

entries.name: Decipher Writing
entries.summary: You attempt to decipher complicated writing or literature on an obscure topic.

entries.name: Defend
entries.summary: You move at half your travel speed with your shield raised.

entries.name: Delay
entries.summary: Trigger Your turn begins.

entries.name: Demoralize
entries.summary: With a sudden shout, a well-timed taunt, or a cutting put-down, you can shake an enemy's resolve.

entries.name: Detect Magic
entries.summary: You cast Detect Magic at regular intervals.

entries.name: Disable a Device
entries.summary: This action allows you to disarm a trap or another complex device.

entries.name: Disarm
entries.summary: Requirements You have at least one hand free.

entries.name: Dismiss
entries.summary: You end an effect that states you can Dismiss it.

entries.name: Drop Prone
entries.summary: You fall Prone.

entries.name: Earn Income
entries.summary: You can use a skill to earn money during downtime.

entries.name: Escape
entries.summary: You attempt to escape from being Grabbed, Immobilized, or Restrained.

entries.name: Feint
entries.summary: Requirements You are within melee reach of the target you attempt to Feint.

entries.name: Fly
entries.summary: Requirements You have a fly Speed.

entries.name: Follow the Expert
entries.summary: Choose an ally attempting a recurring skill check while exploring, such as climbing, or performing a different exploration tactic that requires a skill check (like Avoiding Notice).

entries.name: Force Open
entries.summary: Using your body, a lever, or some other tool, you attempt to forcefully open a door, window, container or heavy gate.

entries.name: Gather Information
entries.summary: You canvass local markets, taverns, and gathering places in an attempt to learn about a specific individual or topic.

entries.name: Grab an Edge
entries.summary: Trigger You fall from or past an edge or handhold.

entries.name: Grapple
entries.summary: Requirements You have at least one free hand and your target is no more than one size larger than you.

entries.name: Hack
entries.summary: Requirements You have a hacking toolkit.

entries.name: Hide
entries.summary: You huddle behind cover or greater cover or deeper into concealment to become Hidden, rather than Observed.

entries.name: High Jump
entries.summary: You Stride, then attempt a DC 30 Athletics check to jump vertically.

entries.name: Hustle
entries.summary: You strain yourself to move at double your travel speed.

entries.name: Identify Magic
entries.summary: Once you discover that an item, location, or ongoing effect is magical, you can spend 10 minutes to try to identify the particulars of its magic.

entries.name: Impersonate
entries.summary: You create a disguise to pass yourself off as someone or something you are not.

entries.name: Implant Augmentation
entries.summary: Prerequisites master in Medicine or Augmentation Specialist Requirements You have a medkit.

entries.name: Install Upgrade
entries.summary: Requirements You must use a repair toolkit.

entries.name: Interact
entries.summary: You use your hand or hands to manipulate an object or the terrain.

entries.name: Investigate
entries.summary: You seek out information about your surroundings while traveling at half speed.

entries.name: Leap
entries.summary: You take a short horizontal or vertical jump.

entries.name: Learn a Spell
entries.summary: Magical Traditions and Skills Each magical tradition has a corresponding skill, as shown on the table below.

entries.name: Lie
entries.summary: You try to fool someone with an untruth.

entries.name: Livestream
entries.summary: Requirements You must have an item with a camera and one free hand, mount, or uniclamp.

entries.name: Long Jump
entries.summary: You Stride, then attempt a DC 15 Athletics check to make a long jump in the direction you were Striding.

entries.name: Make an Impression
entries.summary: With at least 1 minute of conversation, during which you engage in charismatic overtures, flattery, and other acts of goodwill, you seek to make a good impression on someone to make them temporarily agreeable.

entries.name: Maneuver in Flight
entries.summary: Requirements You have a fly Speed.

entries.name: Mount
entries.summary: Requirements You are adjacent to a creature that is at least one size larger than you and is willing to be your mount.

entries.name: Navigate
entries.summary: You plan a short journey.

entries.name: Operate Device
entries.summary: Requirements You are using a computer or similar device.

entries.name: Palm an Object
entries.summary: You pick up a small, unattended object and try not to be noticed.

entries.name: Perform
entries.summary: When making a brief performance-one song, a quick dance, or a few jokes-you use the Perform action.

entries.name: Pick a Lock
entries.summary: Requirements You're holding or wearing an infiltrator's toolkit.

entries.name: Plot Course
entries.summary: You prepare for a longer journey into the stars, likely making use of your starship's Drift Engine (or similar FTL device).

entries.name: Point Out
entries.summary: Requirements A creature is undetected by one or more of your allies but isn't undetected by you.

entries.name: Push Off
entries.summary: Requirements You have at least one hand or leg (or suitable appendage) free, and you're untethered.

entries.name: Raise a Shield
entries.summary: Requirements You are wielding a shield.

entries.name: Ready
entries.summary: You prepare to use an action that will occur outside your turn.

entries.name: Recall Knowledge
entries.summary: You attempt a skill check to try to remember a bit of knowledge regarding a topic related to that skill.

entries.name: Recharge
entries.summary: Requirements You have a battery.

entries.name: Refocus
entries.summary: Requirements You have a focus pool.

entries.name: Release
entries.summary: You release something you're holding in your hand or hands.

entries.name: Repair
entries.summary: Requirements You are holding or wearing a repair toolkit.

entries.name: Repeat a Spell
entries.summary: You repeatedly cast the same spell while moving at half speed.

entries.name: Reposition
entries.summary: Requirements You either have at least one hand free, or you're grabbing or restraining the target.

entries.name: Request
entries.summary: You can make a request of a creature that's friendly or helpful to you.

entries.name: Research
entries.summary: You comb through information to learn more about the topic at hand.

entries.name: Retraining
entries.summary: Retraining offers a way to alter your character choices, which is helpful when you want to take your character in a new direction or change decisions that didn't meet your expectations.

entries.name: Scout
entries.summary: You scout ahead and behind the group to watch danger, moving at half speed.

entries.name: Search
entries.summary: You Seek meticulously for hidden doors, concealed hazards, and so on.

entries.name: Seek
entries.summary: You scan an area for signs of creatures or objects, possibly including secret doors or hazards.

entries.name: Sense Direction
entries.summary: Using the position of astronomical objects in the sky, traits of the geography or flora, or the behavior of fauna, you can stay oriented in the wild.

entries.name: Sense Motive
entries.summary: You try to tell whether a creature's behavior is abnormal.

entries.name: Shove
entries.summary: Requirements You have at least one hand free.

entries.name: Sneak
entries.summary: You attempt to move to another place while becoming or staying undetected.

entries.name: Squeeze
entries.summary: You contort yourself to squeeze through a space so small you can barely fit through.

entries.name: Stand
entries.summary: You stand up from Prone.

entries.name: Steal
entries.summary: You try to take a small object from another creature without being noticed.

entries.name: Step
entries.summary: Requirements Your Speed is at least 10 feet.

entries.name: Stride
entries.summary: You move up to your Speed.

entries.name: Strike
entries.summary: You attack with a weapon you're wielding or with an unarmed attack, targeting one creature within your reach (for a melee attack) or within range (for a ranged attack).

entries.name: Stunt
entries.summary: You perform a stunt while Driving your vehicle, temporarily improving its effective capabilities at the risk of losing control.

entries.name: Subsist
entries.summary: You try to provide food and shelter for yourself, and possibly others as well, with a standard of living.

entries.name: Sustain
entries.summary: Choose one of your effects that has a sustained duration or lists a special benefit when you Sustain it.

entries.name: Swim
entries.summary: You attempt an Athletics check to move a maximum distance of 10 feet through water.

entries.name: Switch Hands
entries.summary: You designate a pair of limbs as your active hands.

entries.name: Take Cover
entries.summary: Requirements You are benefiting from standard cover, are near a feature that allows you to take cover, or are Prone.

entries.name: Track
entries.summary: You follow tracks, moving at up to half your travel Speed, using the Travel Speed rules.

entries.name: Treat Disease
entries.summary: Requirements You're wearing or holding a medkit You spend at least 8 hours caring for a diseased creature.

entries.name: Treat Poison
entries.summary: Requirements You're wearing or holding a medkit You treat a patient to prevent the spread of poison.

entries.name: Treat Wounds
entries.summary: Requirements You're wearing or holding a medkit.

entries.name: Trip
entries.summary: Requirements You have at least one hand free.

entries.name: Tumble Through
entries.summary: You Stride up to your Speed.

entries.name: Flanking
entries.summary: To flank a foe, you and an ally must be on opposite sides of the creature -- a line drawn between the center of your space and the center of your ally's space must pass through opposite sides or opposite corners of the…

entries.name: Cover
entries.summary: Lesser cover grants a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

entries.name: Afflictions
entries.summary: Diseases and poisons are types of afflictions, as are curses and radiation.

entries.name: Difficult terrain
entries.summary: Difficult terrain is any terrain that impedes movement, ranging from particularly rough or unstable surfaces to thick ground cover and countless other impediments.

entries.name: Hero Points
entries.summary: Your heroic deeds earn you Hero Points, which grant you good fortune or let you recover from the brink of death.

entries.name: Initiative
entries.summary: When the GM calls for it, you'll roll initiative to determine your place in the initiative order, which is the sequence in which the encounter's participants will take their turns.

entries.name: Recovery checks
entries.summary: While you're dying, attempt a recovery check at the start of each of your turns.

entries.name: Light and darkness
entries.summary: There are three levels of light: bright light, dim light, and darkness.

entries.name: Hazards
entries.summary: The galaxy is rife with devious traps and security systems meant to protect everything from mundane valuables and sensitive intelligence to ancient magical relics and cutting-edge prototypes.

entries.name: Victory Points
entries.summary: Victory Points (or VP) allow you to track the PCs' progress using a subsystem to go beyond the results of a single check.

entries.name: Influence
entries.summary: Influence is a short-term subsystem wherein the PCs accumulate Influence Points during a social encounter with an NPC to represent their increasing influence.

entries.name: Research
entries.summary: Information is a powerful tool and an invaluable reward.

entries.name: Chases
entries.summary: When the PCs pursue a fleeing target—or someone is hunting them down—adding twists and turns to the pursuit builds suspense and makes the outcome more uncertain than if it were based on Speed alone.

entries.name: Infiltration
entries.summary: Not all elements of an adventure can be resolved with a hail of bullets and magical explosions.

entries.name: Hacking
entries.summary: A computer is only as secure as its weakest vulnerability; every computer has a terminal, and every terminal is another weakness.
